general.notes: Active Electrical Cable (AEC) / Direct Attach Cable (DAC) with coax interconnect between two QSFP-DD modules; not an optical transceiver. Cable length 0.5 to 5 meters (1.6 to 16.4 ft) stated in meters, not km. Power: <4W per side. Storage temperature -40°C to +85°C. Low latency stated as 15nm per end + 4.5nm/m (units as printed). AWG32 (most lengths) and AWG30 (5m SKU). I2C management interface. BER < 10^-15 (post FEC); FEC type not named.
general.suggestions: Consider schema fields for cable_length_m, product_class (AEC/DAC), wire_gauge (AWG), management_bus (I2C), storage_temp_c, and latency; power_consumption_w may need qualifier 'per side' and '<' bound.
